_comment: GODHOOD CAPSTONES — Steve 2026-10-11, requirements reworked 2026-10-13. When a player completes a build (4+ abilities from the godhood's pool incl. a core ability, a discovered synergy, any tier-4 item) after day 80, the game RECOGNIZES it with a played ceremony, grants ONE qualitative godly verb (not +X%), and permanently transforms their visual. Each capstone is the biggest single power spike in the game AND keeps its weakness. Knowledge-gated: the capstone is unknown until you're close (3+ pool abilities). Steve 2026-10-13: endgame only (minDay 80), reachable (pools not exact-6), items = any tier-4.

capstone.cost: Once per fight. Each echo raised is a final death — the village remembers who you spent.
capstone.desc: When an ally falls in a fight you are in, raise their echo: they fight on for 3 rounds as themselves — their stats, their weapon, their voice — then fade. The echo's death is final; they cannot be raised again.
capstone.mechanic: once per fight, on ally death: echo fights 3 rounds then fades permanently
capstone.weakness: Alone, you're just a talker. No allies, no echoes, no godhood.

godhoods.fantasy: Your party doesn't end at death. Fallen allies fight on as echoes.
godhoods.hint: "You're collecting people, little leader. Even the dead ones are starting to listen. I have a WORD for what you're becoming. Not yet. Soon."

mythic.desc: A robed figure in deep indigo, three pale spirit-wisps orbiting — the fallen, visible, still marching.
mythic.title: Wreathed in Echoes

godhoods.name: The Shepherd of the Dead

recognition.beat: The fallen stir. Not all the way. Just enough.
recognition.systemLine: "LADIES AND GENTLEMEN AND THINGS THAT AREN'T! The audience has a NEW WORD and it's SHEPHERD! Not of sheep! OF THE DEAD! They fall! They GET UP! Somebody tell the gamblers the roster just got LONGER!"

capstone.cost: Once per fight — it's set before the first blow. You can't re-choose mid-fight.
capstone.desc: Before any fight begins, dictate its terms: AMBUSH (you strike first, unseen), RANGE (the fight starts at your ideal distance), or GROUND (the terrain favors you). The monster doesn't get a vote.
capstone.mechanic: pre-fight: choose ambush (first strike), range (ideal distance), or ground (terrain edge)
capstone.weakness: If it reaches you, you're just a person with a bow. The terms only matter until contact.

godhoods.fantasy: Nothing escapes you. You choose the fight, the range, the moment.
godhoods.hint: "You don't chase anymore. You ARRIVE. The gamblers have noticed — your fights start before the monster knows it's in one. One more step, little hunter."

mythic.desc: Antlered silhouette, clawed hands, amber predator eyes that catch the light. Tawny and red — the beast you hunted, wearing you.
mythic.title: The Hunt Made Flesh

godhoods.name: The Apex Predator

recognition.beat: Somewhere, something that hunts you decides not to.
recognition.systemLine: "STOP THE PRESSES! STOP ALL PRESSES! The Highbeam Deer just filed a COMPLAINT! It says — and I quote — 'it fears ME now'! Ladies and gentlemen, we have an APEX PREDATOR!"

capstone.cost: Once per day. It costs you 200 kcal of your own — the garden gives, but through you.
capstone.desc: Once per day, call the harvest: enough food for an army, from your hands and the land around you. This is the titan logistics engine — coalitions march because you feed them.
capstone.mechanic: once per day: produce army-scale food (feast for 50+, titan-coalition logistics)
capstone.weakness: You're not a fighter. Your garden needs guards, and everyone knows it.

godhoods.fantasy: The land provides. Scarcity is a rumor. You feed armies.
godhoods.hint: "The land likes you, little gardener. A little TOO much, some say. The seeds lean toward you when you walk past. I wonder what happens when you stop walking past and start ASKING."

mythic.desc: A figure half-lost in vines and blossoms — green-gold, flowers opening along the shoulders, roots at the feet. The garden, walking.
mythic.title: Blooming, Grown-Over

godhoods.name: The Living Garden

recognition.beat: The soil near you is warm. Things are growing that you didn't plant.
recognition.systemLine: "BREAKING! The pantry just reported a SURPLUS and the pantry does NOT do that! Somebody's growing DINNER out of THIN AIR! The audience is EATING! I repeat, the AUDIENCE is EATING! We have a LIVING GARDEN!"

requires._note: forage_identification (ENDGAME-BUILDS.md) does not exist in abilities.json; animal_ken substituted — a forager who knows the land knows its animals.

capstone.cost: A villager's life. Every time. The village judges you — burn twice and earn their love or be exiled.
capstone.desc: When you would die, the phoenix clause burns a living villager — body and all, only ash — and you crawl out of their ashes wherever they were, at 1 HP. No villagers left, no village, and your death sticks. This was already the register; godhood names it.
capstone.mechanic: on lethal damage: burn a random living villager, respawn at their location at 1 HP
capstone.weakness: You're a wall, not a weapon. Things you can't outlast — politics, betrayal, your own village's judgment — still hurt.

godhoods.fantasy: The world tries to kill you and fails. Death is a suggestion — with a name attached.
godhoods.hint: "You've died before, little survivor. Everyone's noticed you keep... not. The gamblers are asking what you'd trade for one more morning. I think you already know the answer."

mythic.desc: A figure of cracked black stone with gold light bleeding through the fractures, ash-grey at the edges. Something that burned and refused to finish.
mythic.title: Cracked Obsidian, Molten Heart

godhoods.name: The Unkillable

recognition.beat: The ash settles. It spells a name. Not yours.
recognition.systemLine: "AND THEY'RE DOWN! THEY'RE — wait. WAIT. That's not their ash! WHOSE ash is that?! THE AUDIENCE IS SCREAMING! The phoenix doesn't rise from ITS ash anymore, folks — it rises from YOURS! We have an UNKILLABLE!"

capstone.cost: Once per fight. You have to SURVIVE to deliver it — die first and the pain dies with you.
capstone.desc: Once per fight, take every wound you've suffered this fight and give it back in a single blow. No cap. The math is simple: the more they hurt you, the more you hurt them.
capstone.mechanic: once per fight: retaliatory strike dealing total damage taken this fight, uncapped
capstone.weakness: Anything that doesn't bleed — beams, politics, starvation — ignores your whole build.

godhoods.fantasy: Walk into impossible fights and walk out. The more they hurt you, the more dangerous you become.
godhoods.hint: "You get hurt, little brawler. A lot. Lately the hurting seems... productive. Like you're SAVING it. The audience is leaning forward. So am I."

mythic.desc: A massive crimson silhouette, weapon fused to the arm, veins of darker red. Bigger than a person. The rage, given a body.
mythic.title: Blood-Forged

godhoods.name: The One-Person Army

recognition.beat: Your blood hits the ground and the ground flinches.
recognition.systemLine: "THEY'RE BLEEDING! THEY'RE LOSING! THE GAMBLERS ARE CASHING OUT! ...Why is it SMILING?! OH NO. OH NO NO NO. FOLKS, THE DAMAGE ISN'T A COST ANYMORE — IT'S A WEAPON! WE HAVE A ONE-PERSON ARMY!"

capstone.cost: Knowing isolates you. Villagers with secrets fear your gaze: -1 trust/day with anyone hiding something, until they confess or leave.
capstone.desc: Lies mechanically fail against you. Deception checks auto-fail. Ambushes that rely on deception don't trigger. When someone lies to you in gossip or dialogue, you KNOW — the game tells you.
capstone.mechanic: passive: all deception vs player auto-fails; lies in dialogue/gossip flagged
capstone.weakness: Knowing the punch is coming doesn't mean you can take it. You're still fragile.

godhoods.fantasy: You know everything. Every lie, every hidden thing, every move before it's made.
godhoods.hint: "You see too much, little detective. People are starting to notice you noticing. The gamblers stopped betting on surprises around you — there aren't any. Something's about to give."

mythic.desc: A figure with eyes on the forehead, the hands, the shoulders — the third eye blazing white-violet. Nothing hidden, nothing forgotten.
mythic.title: Eyes Everywhere

godhoods.name: The All-Seeing

recognition.beat: Every face in the village suddenly looks like an open book. Including yours, reflected.
recognition.systemLine: "SOMEONE JUST LIED TO OUR CHAMPION! The audience is GASPING! ...Why aren't they reacting? OH. OH THEY KNEW. THEY ALWAYS KNEW! Folks, there are no more secrets on this show! We have an ALL-SEEING!"

requires._note: pattern_recognition (ENDGAME-BUILDS.md) does not exist in abilities.json; eagle_eye substituted — it is also required for the key synergy sees_the_weave, which the doc kit could not trigger.

capstone.cost: Name Your Price is once per day; Buy Passage is once per fight; the Guard’s coins shatter and return slowly. Every transaction is taxed — the Audit takes its cut, in goods or in kind. Short on payment, or borrowing the unbuyable, and the market takes MARKERS instead of refusing. Three markers and the Audit comes to collect in person — it takes the finest thing you own.
capstone.desc: Once per day, NAME any item in the world’s catalog: a trader arrives carrying exactly that item. Once per fight, BUY PASSAGE: name a price and the monster takes the coin and leaves — wealth buys the one thing strength can’t: leaving. And always, the coins orbit you: the Gilded Guard intercepts harm before it reaches your flesh. Everything has a price. Even death pauses to count coin.
capstone.mechanic: daily: name any item id — delivered, paid in food-kcal barter (t1 800 / t2 2000 / t3 5000). tier-4 relics are lent, never sold: 2 debt markers. per fight: buy safe passage (monster departs), price scales by wave (w1 1000 / w2 2500 / w3 5000 / w4 10000 / w5 marker-only). passive: Gilded Guard — 4 orbiting coins, each absorbs 50 damage before HP; 1 regenerates per dawn. 3 markers → the Audit collects your most valuable item.
capstone.weakness: Wealth doesn’t stop a beam you can’t buy off. Bought passage is once per fight — the second monster doesn’t haggle. Shattered coins don’t return until dawn. Debts don’t die when you do: the market remembers every marker, and the Audit collects from whoever wears your face next.

godhoods.fantasy: Infinite resources. The market bends to you. You don't find what you need — it finds you.
godhoods.hint: "The traders have stopped haggling with you. They just... agree. Too fast. And the coins — have you noticed the coins don’t fall anymore? They orbit. Slowly. Like they’re waiting to be spent. Someone is keeping a ledger. You can feel the columns. Soon you’ll be allowed to read it."

mythic.desc: A figure in gold, coins orbiting slowly, a balance-scale motif worked into the silhouette. Wealth, given a body and a smile.
mythic.title: Gilded

godhoods.name: The Market God

recognition.beat: Coins you didn’t spend are warm in your pocket. Somewhere, a ledger opens to a page with your name on it — and the ink is still wet. You understand, all at once, that you have never ONCE paid full price for anything in your life. The market was fattening you.
recognition.systemLine: "BREAKING FINANCIAL NEWS! A market just APPEARED in the middle of NOWHERE! Economists are FURIOUS! The invisible hand just got a VISIBLE BODY! We have a MARKET GOD!"

capstone.cost: Once per day. You arrive hungry — the horizon charges 150 kcal toll, taken from your body.
capstone.desc: Cross up to 3 nodes in a single step. The map folds for you. Villages you visit remember the day you simply... arrived.
capstone.mechanic: once per day: instant travel up to 3 nodes, no time cost
capstone.weakness: Finding the dragon's lair and surviving it are different skills. Arrival isn't victory.

godhoods.fantasy: Go anywhere. Know everywhere. Distance is a suggestion.
godhoods.hint: "You walk far, little wanderer. Lately the far seems... nearer. Villages swear you were just there. You were. The map is starting to agree with you instead of the other way around."

mythic.desc: A figure with a streaming cloak that never settles, a compass rose burned into the chest, horizon lines trailing. Blue-grey — the road, wearing a person.
mythic.title: Wind-Torn

godhoods.name: The Farstrider

recognition.beat: The horizon leans toward you, expectantly.
recognition.systemLine: "OUR CHAMPION WAS HERE! NOW THEY'RE — wait, that's THREE VILLAGES AWAY! THAT'S NOT POSSIBLE! THE MAP JUST FOLDED! FOLDED LIKE LAUNDRY! We have a FARSTRIDER!"

requires._noteSynergy: Stormcaller (ENDGAME-BUILDS.md) does not exist; rain_catcher (rain_dancer+dowsing) is the real synergy for this kit.

capstone.cost: Once per fight. And phasing is a retreat, always — you cannot phase and hold ground in the same breath.
capstone.desc: Once per fight, when a hit would land — you are simply not there. The blow passes through the space you were. You were never really here.
capstone.mechanic: once per fight: negate one hit entirely (any source, any size)
capstone.weakness: You can't hold ground. Villages need people who stay. This weakness is permanent — godhood doesn't fix it.

godhoods.fantasy: Untethered. You exist between places — hard to hit, hard to find, impossible to pin down.
godhoods.hint: "You're hard to find lately, little drifter. Even for me, and I see EVERYTHING. The gamblers bet on where you'll be and lose. Where ARE you, exactly?"

mythic.desc: A half-transparent figure, glitching between states — indigo and shadow, offset duplicates trailing. Here, and not.
mythic.title: Phased

godhoods.name: The Between

recognition.beat: For a moment, you are in two places. Then you choose the better one.
recognition.systemLine: "THE BLOW LANDED! IT'S OVER! ...Why is everyone staring at empty air? WHERE — OH. OH THEY'RE BEHIND IT. THEY WERE NEVER THERE! FOLKS, WE HAVE A GHOST! WE HAVE THE BETWEEN!"

capstone.cost: You take the damage — really. And every wound you carry makes you the priority target, which you already were.
capstone.desc: When an ally would take a wound, take it yourself instead. Redirected wounds cannot drop you below 1 HP — you keep standing. But strain accumulates: at 3 strains in one fight, you collapse (alive, but out).
capstone.mechanic: redirect ally damage to self; redirected damage can't drop below 1 HP; 3 strains/fight = collapse
capstone.weakness: You're the priority target, and you can't heal yourself mid-fight as easily. Everyone aims at the light.

godhoods.fantasy: No one dies on your watch. You take their wounds as your own and keep standing.
godhoods.hint: "You catch people, little caregiver. Falls, fevers, failures — you're always there first. Lately it looks less like catching and more like... absorbing. I have a word for it. Soon."

mythic.desc: A figure in white-gold light, shielding wings half-unfurled, a soft halo. Others' wounds visible as light on the skin — carried, not hidden.
mythic.title: Radiant Guardian

godhoods.name: The Undying Ward

recognition.beat: Someone else's blood is on your hands. It was never yours. It is now.
recognition.systemLine: "THEY'RE DOWN! THE MEDIC'S DOWN! ...Why are they STANDING? THAT WOUND WAS ON THE OTHER ONE! FOLKS, THE WOUNDS ARE MOVING! THEY'RE — THEY'RE TAKING THEM! We have an UNDYING WARD!"

godhoods.name: The Voice of the Relay
godhoods.fantasy: Every message in and out passes through your hands. You are the voice the world listens for.
godhoods.hint: "Little switchboard. Every word in the region passes through YOUR hands now. I have a WORD for what you're becoming. Not yet. Soon."

requires.note: Hold the relay office and unlock all six comm-field abilities (3 shared + 3 from your light/dark branch) through the Relay endgame path.

capstone.desc: Your words reach any allied village instantly — no runner, no delay, no garbling. Once per day, speak a command every ally hears at once.
capstone.mechanic: once per day: instant message to all allies; once per fight: rally cry (allies +10 morale)
capstone.cost: Each use erodes grounding by 5. At grounding 0, you are more System than human — the voice remains, the person fades.
capstone.weakness: You are the single point of failure. If you fall, the network goes dark. And every word costs you humanity.

mythic.title: Wreathed in Signal
mythic.desc: A human silhouette with screen-eyes, signal threads radiating outward — the switchboard made flesh. Still human-shaped. Barely.

recognition.beat: The region goes quiet. Every relay, every runner, every signal fire — all waiting on your word.
recognition.systemLine: "LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! The switchboard has a NAME and it's YOURS! Every word in the region passes through ONE pair of hands! The galaxy is LISTENING!"
